section.title: Graphing a Line and Describing Characteristics
section.para: There are many ways to graph an equation of a line. One way is to use the \(x\)-intercepts and \(y\)-intercepts as two points on the line.
Graph \(3x -6y =18\) using the intercepts, then identify key characteristics.

Step 1 - Find the \(x\)-intercept.
To find the \(x\)-intercept, let \(y=0\).

\((6,0)\) is the \(x\)-intercept
The \(x\)-intercept is also called a solution or zero.

Step 2 -Find the \(y\)-intercept.
To find the \(y\)-intercept, let \(x=0\).
Step 3 -Graph the line by connecting the \(y\)-intercepts.

image.alt: A plot of y intercepts of the equation 3x - 6y =18.

section.para: Step 4 - Find the slope of the line.
